name: Lidarr
description: Finds albums by the artists you follow, and files them in your music library.
notes: The first visit asks you to choose how to sign in. Under Settings → Download Clients, add qBittorrent or SABnzbd by the server's LAN address and port; Prowlarr fills in the indexers. Add /data/media/music as the root folder, and point Navidrome at the same music. Give every download app the same Media and downloads folder, with downloads in /data/downloads and your library in /data/media, so finished files move into the library without being copied. The folder must belong to the apps' user (or set APPS_MEDIA_UID and APPS_MEDIA_GID to its owner); point Jellyfin at the library inside it.
